title: Public Safety Data Analytics Platform & Support Services
agency: COURT SERVICES AND OFFENDER SUPERVISION AGENCY.COURT SERVICES AND OFFENDER SUPERVISION AGENCY.COURT SERVICES  OFFENDER SUPV AGCY
description_text:
Amendment 0003 adds FAR clauses by text inadvertantly omitted in the initally issued solicitation. The quotation due date and time identified in Amendment 0001 remains the same. 

Amendment 0002 replaces Attachment J-1, Statement of Work, from the version provided with Amendment 0001.The quotation due date and time identified in Amendment 0001 remains the same. The quotation due date idenified in SAM.gov when Amendment 0001 was posted is corrected to reflect "12:00PM" on July 14, 2026. 

Amendment 0001 provides responses to all questions received, makes revisions to solicitation 9594CS26Q0053, and extend the due date for past performance questionnaires and quotations. 

The Contractor shall provide a public safety data analytics platform and support services. The solicitation section L.6.3 stipulates the Quoter’s proposed public safety data analytics cloud platform MUST hold a current Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) Moderate Authorization at the exact time and date set for submission of quotations. Failure to provide the required evidence or proposing a solution that is currently "In Process", "FedRAMP Ready," or possessing a status lower than Moderate Authorization will result in elimination from the competition.
